name: Portainer
description: Portainer is a container management tool for deploying, troubleshooting, and securing applications across cloud, data centers, and IoT. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Portainer as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Web UI for managing Docker containers. Deploy Portainer with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
